name: Forced Subtitles (Whisper)
description: Makes forced subtitles (just the foreign-language lines) and/or full subtitles in any of 97 languages, using a local Whisper service on your own GPU.
overview: Forced and full subtitles in 97 languages, generated locally with Whisper

versions.changelog: Generate subtitles from the ... menu of any movie or episode (web client, admins), with a notice when they're ready. Can be turned off in the plugin settings.

One-click Windows installer (Install-ForcedSubs.bat) attached to the release. Installer fixes: no longer mistakes the Microsoft Store python shortcut for Python, and the service finds a newly installed ffmpeg at logon.
Full subtitles and 97 subtitle languages (translated with NLLB-200), 50+ settings including auto-processing of new items, cancel, API key and path mapping, plus many fixes.
First release: generate forced English subtitles for foreign-language lines with a local Whisper service. Dashboard page with a Generate button and a library-wide scheduled task.
